definitions.title: Taylor's Theorem with Remainder (Lagrange Form)
definitions.statement: If f has continuous derivatives through order n + 1 on an interval containing a and x, then the error R_n(x) in approximating f(x) by its n-th Taylor polynomial P_n(x) equals the (n+1)-th derivative evaluated at some point c strictly between a and x.
conditions: c is between a and x
definitions.explanation: Generalizes the Mean Value Theorem to higher-order polynomial approximations.
definitions.keyTakeaway: A Taylor series converges to f(x) if and only if lim R_n(x) = 0.
